blocks.text: Draw warm currents in red and cold currents in blue using the map on the slides.

points: Waves on top of deep water
Some deep creatures make their own light

panels.title: Currents
points: Water moves like rivers in the sea
They carry heat around the world

model.title: Why is the UK milder than Canada at the same latitude?

parts.text: Find the Gulf Stream on the map
It flows north-east to the UK

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The warm Gulf Stream heats the UK's seas and air

keywords.def: the top 200 m, where sunlight reaches
about 200 m to 1,000 m: dim light
water moving in one direction through the ocean
a warm current flowing across the Atlantic towards Europe

questions.q: Where do sea plants grow: sunlight or midnight zone?
What moves water around the oceans?
Name the warm current that reaches the UK.
Core: Draw an ocean depth column with the three zones, their depths, and one creature or plant for each zone.
questions.a: Three zones with correct depths and suitable examples (e.g. seaweed, jellyfish, anglerfish)

questions.q: Extend: On the current map, trace the Gulf Stream and write where it starts and ends.
questions.a: From the Gulf of Mexico across the Atlantic towards the UK and north-west Europe

questions.q: Stretch: What might happen to UK weather if the Gulf Stream weakened?

questions.a: C) Midnight zone. No sunlight reaches below about 1,000 m, so it is the midnight zone.

questions.q: Big question: why is the deep ocean pitch black?
questions.a: Sunlight cannot reach below about 1,000 m, so it is dark at any time
